rule: one entry per run the audit lists under the 11 px cap floor. The run ids here must equal the audit's summary.runs_under_cap_floor exactly and every number must be the audit's own measured value, so a new under-floor run cannot pass by quoting an old exception and an exception cannot outlive the defect it describes.

exceptions.why_it_cannot_absorb_an_11px_cap: The pinned 74x74 box paints a tilted luggage tag whose light kraft face is a ~58x29 px strip on a -35.5 deg axis; an 11 px cap needs a 16.67 px step, a 53.3 x 36.7 px block, which leaves the face in any orientation. Turning the run onto the face (-30 deg) fixed the contrast (5.271:1 / 5.918:1, 0 of 67 / 41 glyph-core pixels under 3.0:1); the cap is the exception. Nothing clips at the lift size (0 px), the words simply leave the face.

Two-line title in a G2-pinned 118x140 board with a 75 px cover: at the 16.67 px step the title block grows 39.19 -> 46.66 px and its ARTICLE clips 6 px of height at both widths (probe-measured). 16.67 px already sits between the body (16) and lead (20) token steps, so no step clears 11 px without clipping.
